node.statement: At every matrix level q, positivity of (id_q tensor Upsilon') and conjugation by I_q tensor c imply positivity of id_q tensor Upsilon; hence Upsilon is CP. Also Upsilon(I)=c*b*c=I by functional calculus, so Upsilon is unital and therefore UCP by def-ucp-map.
